steps.name: apply-stage16b-sequence-dagger-teacher-injection
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=34d164cd7b5a68ed7b46228e7aef8539c7539c6e; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage16/apply_sequence_dagger_teacher_injection.py > /tmp/apply-sequence-dagger-teacher-injection.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-sequence-dagger-teacher-injection.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py; .venv/bin/python -m py_compile tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage16b-sequence-dagger-teacher-injection
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_dagger.py tests/test_climate_dagger_distributed.py -q; .venv/bin/python tools/schema/generate_climate_contract.py --check; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage16b
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -A; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Inject Sequence Teacher into DAgger'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
